qualifications: Same-host monotonic intervals, clipped to reset-to-result; union accounting prevents double-counting concurrent/nested timers.
API time is measured request transport duration. Policy action timers include local policy and skill work, not pure GPU kernel time.
Native control timers cover the instrumented native take_action_batch call, including associated simulation/rendering work.
Remaining time is unassigned observation/communication/reset/serialization/other work; it is not proven to be one specific bottleneck.
Process startup/warmup/teardown remain separately reported in whole-job timing. These episode intervals do not replace whole-batch timing.
No corresponding project-A wall-time intervals are public; no cross-project end-to-end ratio follows.
